atlases.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: in-between animation sprite atlas for an existing 2D beach volleyball game.
Input image is the identity/style reference ONLY. Select ONLY FIRST ROW: the adult male in RED, brown spiky hair, red headband with tails, red sleeveless white-palm jersey, red shorts, wristbands. This SAME athlete must appear in all 24 cells. Preserve their identity, exact outfit, palette, athletic adult anatomy, face and crisp arcade pixel-art rendering from the input. No other athletes.
Generate a production-quality TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas, 1536x1024, EXACTLY SIX columns by FOUR rows, each cell 256x256. Every cell contains one full-body pose of the SAME athlete facing RIGHT, with constant anatomy scale and fixed root alignment. All sprites fit entirely inside their cell, with at least 8px transparent padding. Horizontal pelvis/root center x128 per cell. Ground line y246 per cell for grounded poses, and virtual feet anchor y246 for airborne poses; no global displacement across cells. Head around y40 in neutral stance. Do not scale crouched poses up; knees bend naturally. Keep hands and feet uncut. Transparent background, NO painted backdrop, ground shadows, lettering, borders, guides, balls, net, UI or motion trails.
Each ROW is a SIX-FRAME animation, strictly left-to-right chronological. Create DISTINCT drawn in-between poses, never six duplicates or translated copies. Subtle pixel-cluster shading matching input.
ROW 1 / IDLE LOOP: six stages of a gentle athletic ready/breathing cycle: neutral, inhale slightly rising chest, inhale peak, settling, slight knee flex/exhale, return near neutral. Fixed feet, slight arm and hair movement. No walking in this row.
ROW 2 / RUN LOOP: six consecutive phases of one complete RUN cycle to the RIGHT: right-foot contact with left arm forward; recoil with knees bending; passing pose left knee moving forward; LEFT-foot contact with RIGHT arm forward; recoil opposite legs; opposite passing pose right knee forward. Alternate the lead leg, with distinct bent knees, feet and opposite arm swing. Run in place with consistent root, don't drift horizontally.
ROW 3 / ATTACK NONLOOP: six stages of an airborne volleyball spike: 1 ready with hitting arm lifting; 2 windup elbow bending behind head; 3 maximum cock with torso rotated; 4 contact fully extended hitting arm high and forward; 5 follow-through arm sweeping diagonally downward across torso; 6 recovery arm lowered forward, knees preparing to descend. Anatomically correct shoulder rotation, one hitting hand, no balls. Clearly DIFFERENT arm positions.
ROW 4 / JUMP NONLOOP: six stages of an ordinary jump with NO spike: 1 anticipation deep knee bend arms swung back; 2 takeoff legs extending arms swinging upward; 3 ascent legs folded and arms raised; 4 apex balanced with bent knees and relaxed outspread arms; 5 descent legs extending downward, arms forward; 6 LANDING deep knee compression and arms forward for balance, soles on baseline.
Maintain the same viewing angle, hair accessories, clothing white trim and white palm motif throughout. Bare feet. This sheet will be cut mechanically at the exact regular grid. No overlap across cell boundaries.
